tagline: Leading the Mobility Transition with Hybrid Excellence
hero_kpi_rationale: Toyota dominates the hybrid segment with proven technology for 25 years. This KPI reflects its key competitive advantage in the energy transition, ahead of the widespread adoption of electric vehicles.

kpis.name: Hybrid and electric share of sales
kpis.explanation: Proportion of hybrid and electric vehicles among total sales.
kpis.description: Toyota continues to accelerate on low-emission vehicles, with a growing share of hybrid models in its overall mix.

kpis.name: Vehicle sales in units
kpis.explanation: Total number of vehicles sold worldwide during the year.
kpis.description: Toyota remains the world's largest automaker by volume, with strong performance in emerging markets and North America.

kpis.name: Adjusted operating margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit divided by revenue, excluding exceptional items.
kpis.description: Sustained margin driven by production efficiency and geographic diversification, despite investments in new technologies.

kpis.name: Free cash flow
kpis.description: High free cash flow enables Toyota to fund dividends, share buybacks, and technological transition simultaneously.

kpis.name: Capital expenditures
kpis.explanation: Annual spending on new equipment or capacity.
kpis.description: Rising Capex reflects Toyota's commitment to electric vehicles, safety, and connected mobility.

kpis.name: Annual dividend per share
kpis.explanation: Total amount paid to shareholders per share over the year in Japanese yen.
kpis.description: Toyota maintains a growing dividend policy, reflecting its financial strength and confidence in its trajectory. For fiscal year 2025, the annual dividend amounts to 90 yen per share (40 yen interim dividend and 50 yen year-end dividend).

kpis.name: Multi-year EV and software investment plan
kpis.explanation: Planned multi-year investment in electric vehicles and embedded software.
kpis.description: Toyota has announced a 10 trillion yen multi-year plan to accelerate its development in electric vehicles and software technologies.

kpis.name: Share repurchase authorization
kpis.explanation: Maximum amount authorized for share buybacks in trillions of yen.
kpis.description: The share buyback ceiling was raised to 1.2 trillion yen on September 24, 2024, following a board resolution, demonstrating a commitment to shareholder value. Toyota resolved to increase the buyback limit to 530 million shares for a maximum amount of 1.2 trillion yen.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions (treasury).
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + share buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du bénéfice net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

ai_positioning.summary: Company TM does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its annual report.
